title: Beautiful!
text: Beautiful!. We have several different Dragonware glassware. These are beautiful! They are an excellent quality and what I would expect from the brand. They are durable and don't feel cheap at all. We love the unique diamond shape of these.

product_metadata.title: Dragon Glassware Wine Glasses, Clear Diamond Shaped Barware, Large Drinkware for Red and White Wine, Unique Gift for Wine Lovers, 18 oz Capacity, Set of 2
features: Elegant Diamond Design: These unique wine glasses allow your drink to aerate as it is poured and swirled inside the glass; perfect for wine, champagne, whiskey and more
Designed to Impress: Using only high-quality, crystal clear glass, these glasses will be the talk of the party
Ready to Gift: Makes a wonderful choice for wine lovers and oenophiles and comes in luxury gift packaging
Sustainable and Reusable: Crystal clear, lead-free, high quality glass that is dishwasher, refrigerator and freezer safe; suitable for daily use and cleans easily
Professional Quality: Comes with lifetime limited manufacturer’s warranty
